name: Exp_ColorZerolagTriXOSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagTriXOSMA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag composite of five weighted TriX (Triple Exponential Moving Average) oscillators smoothed with OSMA-style histogram logic. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward (value rising from below) and sell positions when the histogram turns downward, with configurable permissions for entry and exit on each side.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagTriXOSMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标是五个加权TriX振荡器的零滞后复合体，经过OSMA式直方图平滑处理。当直方图由下转上时开多仓，由上转下时开空仓，支持独立配置多空方向的入场和出场权限。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于零滞后TriX-OSMA复合指标捕捉动量方向变化。入场条件为：当指标直方图的第2根值小于第3根值（下降趋势）且第1根值大于第2根值（开始回升）时触发买入信号；当第2根值大于第3根值（上升趋势）且第1根值小于第2根值（开始回落）时触发卖出信号。出场条件分为两部分：一是反向信号触发平仓（买入信号时平空头，卖出信号时平多头），二是固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持四种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损自由保证金比例、按亏损余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，默认0.1即10%的资金参与单笔交易。策略采用多周期TriX加权叠加（5个不同周期的TriX乘以不同权重因子0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43）来消除滞后性，这是其核心创新点。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the zero-lag TriX-OSMA composite indicator to capture momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the histogram's bar[2] value is less than bar[3] (downtrend) and bar[1] is greater than bar[2] (starting to rise); a sell signal triggers when bar[2] is greater than bar[3] (uptrend) and bar[1] is less than bar[2] (starting to decline). Exit conditions have two components: reverse signals close opposite positions (buy signal closes shorts, sell signal closes longs), and fixed stop-loss/take-profit in points. Position sizing supports four modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of loss-based free margin, percentage of loss-based balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 (10% of funds per trade). The strategy uses a weighted superposition of five TriX indicators with different periods and weight factors (0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43) to eliminate lag, which is its core innovation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易中投入的存款资金比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数确定方式（自由保证金/余额/亏损保证金/亏损余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method (free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lots)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大允许价格滑点点数

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 零滞后TriX复合指标设计有效减少传统均线的滞后性，提高信号及时性
五层权重因子叠加（权重和为1.00）使短中长周期动量均衡融合，减少单一周期噪音
支持独立控制多空方向的入场和出场权限，灵活性高，可实现只做多或只做空策略
设有新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，提供基本的风险控制手段
pros_en: Zero-lag TriX composite indicator design effectively reduces traditional moving average lag, improving signal timeliness
Five weighted factor superposition (weights sum to 1.00) balances short/medium/long-term momentum, reducing single-period noise
Independent control of buy/sell entry and exit permissions offers high flexibility, enabling long-only or short-only strategies
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents repeated position opening within the same bar
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 仅依赖单一指标的直方图拐点信号，缺乏多维度确认，容易在震荡行情中频繁假信号
止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点数值偏大，对不同品种和波动率环境缺乏自适应能力
缺少点差过滤和波动率过滤，在高点差或低波动环境下可能频繁无效交易
没有仓位加仓或信号强度分级机制，所有信号等权处理
依赖外部自定义指标文件（ColorZerolagTriXOSMA），指标缺失时EA无法运行且错误信息不够详细
cons_en: Relies solely on histogram turning points from a single indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large, lacking adaptability to different instruments and volatility environments
No spread filter or volatility filter, potentially causing frequent ineffective trades in high-spread or low-volatility conditions
No position scaling or signal strength grading mechanism — all signals are treated equally
Depends on external custom indicator file (ColorZerolagTriXOSMA), and the EA fails with insufficient error detail if the indicator is missing
improvements: 增加点差过滤和ATR波动率过滤，避免在高点差和低波动环境下无效入场
引入多时间周期确认机制，例如要求高一级时间周期趋势方向一致才入场
将固定止损止盈改为ATR动态止损止盈，使风险控制自适应市场波动率
增加信号强度评估（如直方图变化幅度），根据强度调整仓位大小而非固定比例
improvements_en: Add spread filter and ATR volatility filter to avoid invalid entries in high-spread and low-volatility environments
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher timeframe trend direction alignment before entry
Replace fixed stop-loss/take-profit with ATR-based dynamic stops for volatility-adaptive risk control
Add signal strength assessment (e.g., histogram change magnitude) and adjust position size based on strength rather than fixed ratio

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在流动性差或点差扩大的品种上可能以不利价格频繁入场
固定止损止盈不适配不同波动率环境，可能在小波动品种上止损过宽、大波动品种上止损过窄
没有最大持仓数量限制或日内亏损限制，极端行情下可能连续开仓导致大额亏损
SignalBar=0时跳过新K线检测，可能在同一根未完成K线上反复触发信号
risk_points_en: No spread filter — may frequently enter at unfavorable prices on instruments with poor liquidity or widened spreads
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit does not adapt to different volatility environments, potentially too wide for low-volatility or too narrow for high-volatility instruments
No maximum position count limit or daily loss limit — consecutive position openings during extreme market conditions could lead to significant losses
When SignalBar=0, new bar detection is skipped, potentially triggering signals repeatedly on the same incomplete bar

It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward (value rising from below) and sell positions when the histogram turns downward, with configurable permissions for entry and exit on each side.
